title: The Girl Who Borrowed Magic
excerpt: In a kingdom where magic is inherited, she discovers hers belongs to someone else.

sections.title: The Borrowing
paragraphs: Magic arrived in families the way eye color did—predictable, documented, inherited.
So when blue fire appeared between her fingers, the royal registry sent soldiers before her mother finished screaming.

sections.title: The Name
paragraphs: The spell did not recognize Ilyra. It recognized another name.
Every time she used the magic, she remembered a life she had never lived.

sections.title: The Return
paragraphs: The kingdom wanted its prince back. Ilyra wanted herself.
At the gates of the palace, she finally understood that borrowed magic still belonged to the person choosing what to do with it.
She entered under her own name.
